messages.text: The source contract resolves into four durable boundaries: SQL-backed catalog/commerce queries, typed Start server/API entry points, route-level product flows, and a responsive masonry interaction layer. The database must own totals and analytics—not the React components—and the gallery needs actual cohesive media before its card dimensions can be finalized, so I’m preparing the prompt artwork now rather than filling cards with CSS stand-ins.
